title: MCP tools: world exploration and performance
label: Follow the tool request
definition: An agent tool is a named function with a description, checked inputs and a structured result. MCP connects agent applications to tool providers. Maple Line uses browser-side WebMCP tools over its live development inspector.
impact: Treat the tool layer like an API for questions about the running game: small responses, explicit units, useful errors and the same application rules as the player interface.
present: The development game exposes world snapshots, object search and inspection, route sampling, a runtime profile and bounded performance measurements. Native browser registration depends on the browser; a page-local fallback uses the same validated handlers.
next: Add a focused diagnostic tool only when an agent question cannot be answered by the existing readers. Start with a compact read-only response and test its input limits before adding any mutation.
accept: Reject unknown fields and invalid measurement durations. Verify object lookup, empty results, unavailable browser information and registry disposal. Compare measurement context before drawing conclusions about performance.
tradeoff: Large snapshots consume time and context. Frequent inspection can itself add work. Read-only annotations describe intent; executor validation and application rules enforce behavior.
steps: Choose a named tool and arguments.
Reject arguments outside the tool contract.
Read state or collect a bounded timing sample.
Return the result with context and limits.
observation: The picture shows the train and scenery an agent may inspect. A screenshot cannot reveal current speed, object identity or frame timing by itself. The development tools answer those questions from the running game; the experiment below is an illustration, not a connection to a live game.
exercise: Try next: in the local development game, read world state, find a carriage, inspect its returned UUID, then collect a three-second performance sample. Explain what the data proves and what still needs a visual check.
